tagline: One of the most experienced international operators in the offshore energy industry
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of active vessels is the primary revenue driver in the offshore sector, directly correlated to oil and gas exploration activity. It is a key indicator of capacity and competitive positioning.

kpis.name: Active Fleet Size
kpis.explanation: Total number of vessels available to serve the offshore industry.
kpis.description: Active fleet size is a direct indicator of operational capacity. The acquisition of 37 Solstad vessels in 2023 significantly increased the fleet.
kpis.signal: Fleet consolidated at 208 vessels in 2025, following Solstad acquisition.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of services, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves in 2025, supported by higher utilization and day rates.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement driven by better fleet utilization.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Spending on the acquisition or improvement of vessels and physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex investments support fleet modernization and technical compliance.
kpis.signal: Increased capex to modernize the integrated fleet post-Solstad.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount allocated to repurchase own shares to reduce the number of shares outstanding.
kpis.description: In 2025, Tidewater repurchased and retired 2,290,204 shares for approximately $90.0 million, excluding commissions and excise tax. In February 2025, the Board approved a $90.3 million program and in August 2025, an additional $500 million program.
kpis.signal: $90M share repurchase completed in 2025 under approved buyback programs.

kpis.name: Debt Level
kpis.explanation: Total amount of long-term debt after refinancing.
kpis.description: On July 7, 2025, Tidewater issued $650 million of 9.125% senior unsecured notes due July 2030. Proceeds were used to repay the majority of existing debt as of June 30, 2025, including accrued interest and early redemption premiums.
kpis.signal: Successful refinancing with $650M issuance of 9.125% senior notes in July 2025.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Headcount increased following the Solstad acquisition in 2023 and in anticipation of the Wilson Sons acquisition in 2026.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth linked to integration of Solstad acquisitions.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $0.119B in the latest fiscal year (FY2019).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.335B in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Solstad Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to acquire 37 vessels in 2023.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Solstad vessels was completed on July 5, 2023, for a total cash purchase price of approximately $594.2 million, consisting of a base price of $577.0M plus price adjustments of $3.0M, working capital items of $3.2M, and estimated transaction costs of $11.0M.
kpis.signal: Transformational acquisition of 37 vessels on July 5, 2023, for $594.2M.

kpis.name: Wilson Sons Deal
kpis.explanation: Value of the acquisition agreement for Wilson Sons vessels in Brazil.
kpis.description: On February 22, 2026, Tidewater announced a definitive agreement to acquire all shares held by Wilson Sons Ultratug Participações S.A. and its subsidiary Atlantic Offshore Services S.A. from Wilson Sons S.A., Ultranav International II, S.A., and Remolcadores Ultratug Limitada for an aggregate cash purchase price of $500.0 million on a debt-free, cash-free basis, subject to adjustments including a reduction for assumed debt of approximately $261.0M. The transaction is expected to close in the last quarter of the second quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion into the Brazilian market with acquisition of 22 vessels announced on February 22, 2026.

risks.title: Sector downturns
risks.score_rationale: Downturns in the oil and gas industry have often resulted in reduced client spending and lower demand for our services.

risks.title: Climate and sustainability risks
risks.score_rationale: Factors associated with climate change and sustainability issues could have negative effects on the company's business, reputation, operating results, and financial condition.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Increased competition in the offshore marine services industry could have negative effects on the pricing of our services.

risks.title: Credit and cash flow risks
risks.score_rationale: We may not be able to generate sufficient cash flow to meet our debt service obligations.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in applicable laws and regulations, including those under development, may increase our compliance costs and operational risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity attacks against our vessels, facilities, or those of third parties could result in potential damages or harm to our reputation.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical events, such as wars, terrorist attacks, and international hostilities, could have negative effects on our operations and financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: TDW has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its filed documents. Therefore, its position on these topics is not clear from the provided information.
